headline: Purdue and Baylor now lead the division in wins
dek: Purdue has eighteen wins after beating Southern Illinois, and Baylor matched that count by beating Lamar. North Carolina had as many wins as both of them before last night, and it did not play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
